We have had nothing short of the most disgusting experience. New patients and first appointment for my 4 year old son, today. I am not one to publicly complain but I am shocked, hurt and most importantly advocating for my son. Firstly when I called, the HCA refused to help despite the request being simple, but I understand this, especially with a child. I advised I’d be happy to make do until tomorrow and wait to see a nurse, the receptionist went and spoke to the GP instead to which he advised us to go to hospital - I had asked for an appointment for medical tape to be changed following surgery. The tape was not in the area of surgery site, it had simply stretched away from the “thing” it was holding up (I won’t go into extensive personal detail). I stated to the booking adviser that I was not comfortable putting my son in the car for a round 50+ minute journey, and that it is not sound medical advice for the surgery he had done due to the straps of his seat compressing on the area. The receptionist put my son down for an E-consult. 4.5hrd later I had a call and was offered an appointment at 5.35pm, we arrived on time to then wait for over 40 minutes - the GP did not have another patient in with him nor leave in the time we were there! There was no apology until I asked if everything was ok. After explaining what I would like help with he did not look at the tape, wandered out of the room to find something similar but then refused to help remove the old and reapply new, he was giving us it to take home. I would’ve gone to the chemist if I was comfortable doing it myself but after my own experience and knowledge I know there is a solution they can use to easily and pain free remove the tape. He stated the solution to remove the tape was in the nurses room and he wouldn’t know where to look, when I questioned further he said the cupboards might be locked, then proceeded to shift the blame onto the hospital for not providing an aftercare kit. He refused to ask the receptionist for keys because he wouldn’t know where to look and they *might* not have the solution. I am beyond disgusted and let down. My son is entitled to this care and should not have been put in this position by any “medical professional / setting”. Had the GP have looked at my sons belly he would’ve noticed a small skin graze that could do with being treated too. This raises a HUGE concern for the safeguarding of other children, any wound or mark would go unnoticed by that man. The “GP’s” desk had rubbish from a previous appointment, a packet that was ripped open with fluid on the desk. Unsure what because I didn’t read it, but a small blue packet. Also, there was treatment bed tissue shoved under the bed from a previous appointment! Before leaving he recommended I try get in with the nurse the following day, I said I will be deregistering us he said “fair enough”. Never in my life have I experienced such lack of effort, care, compassion, laziness, accountability and common sense.\nIf I could give 0 stars I would however, the singular star is awarded to the two receptionists I have encountered- Kevin \u0026 the female that helped with our registration, they were very friendly and efficient.",null,[0,237]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data\u003d!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tvMGVrWjRWbDh0WXpobmFIaGFXVFZqVDAwNGEyYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x6e96c513e89534e6!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOko0ekZ4Vl8tYzhnaHhaWTVjT004a2c%7C%7C?hl\u003den"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId\u003dCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tvMGVrWjRWbDh0WXpobmFIaGFXVFZqVDAwNGEyYxAB\u0026t\u003d1\u0026entityid\\u0026wv\u003d1\u0026d\u003d286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjNuZaoqLCTAxX_LGMBHeLvEWcQoykIEygB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjNuZaoqLCTAxX_LGMBHeLvEWcQ0pMFCBEoBQ"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCaHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMlYwZG10MU1WOWZSV2hEVjB4UFV6aEVYMDFGTUhsbWFrTjRPRUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpZT0VOYU5qSXRVemRWV1VGRFNVRQ\u003d\u003d"],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJZXZvNUhIdnV1RnlBRRAB",["0x0:0x6e96c513e89534e6",null,1746548127700472,1746548127700472,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113712591414126029376/reviews?hl\u003den"],null,null,["Linda Clegg","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJpuIEtMGsKjepC00JGNviTJbl9yNKbpxOVtw-7sWqNuk61tw\u003ds120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113712591414126029376?hl\u003den"],"113712591414126029376",null,1,0,null,[0,2,1],0,["1 review",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjNuZaoqLCTAxX_LGMBHeLvEWcQ7LoGCBUoAA"]]]],null,"10 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["The new booking system is useless and not fit for purpose.
